scope: Independent read-only review of CPR decoder/tests and import/report/Save As integration against pinned native archive/tempo contracts and structurally decoded shipped fixtures. No app source modification by reviewer, no target execution, no new broad test run.
status: Three actionable findings corrected and final source reviewed; no remaining actionable defect found within this scoped review

resolved_findings.location: CPRProject.swift tempo() count guard, final line652
resolved_findings.problem: Zero serialized tempo records were accepted and could be followed directly by a valid fixed float and enabled u16, allowing a native-rejected tempo object to produce a recovery claim. Native0x10173bdac returns false when signed count<1.
resolved_findings.resolution: Guard now requires count>0 as well as byte/count bounds.
resolved_findings.test: zeroRecordTempoCannotBecomeRecoveredFixedTempo uses an exact self-authored zero-record payload, with a positive one-record control and no-destination assertion.

resolved_findings.problem: Class registry declarations reused BOM-aware user-string normalization. A leading EFBBBF could be removed from a class name, promoting otherwise distinct native registry bytes to a supported class. Native class helper0x10221eb28 returns raw bytes; registry0x1022137ec uses strcmp, independently bound to original stub0x103881bcc.
resolved_findings.resolution: Separate className reader requires unchanged bounded ASCII and exactly one terminal NUL; user-visible names retain their separate BOM-aware decoder. This is a deliberately strict ASCII subset, not a full native string policy.
resolved_findings.test: classRegistryKeysDoNotNormalizeUserStringBOMs has ordinary-class positive control, leading BOM, suffix/embedded NUL controls.

resolved_findings.location: CPRProject.swift importProject(), final lines157-179; compatibilityReport() bound
resolved_findings.problem: Import report writes had no matching8MiB read limit, so an input within source/object/string limits could publish a package later refused by the app loader.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both paths use maximumReportBytes; encoded report checked before staging creation; staging compatibilityReport validated before final move.
resolved_findings.test: oversizedReportCannotPublishAnUnopenableProject constructs100 distinct audio skeletons with49,000-byte names: source<5MB, report>8MiB. Import refuses with source unchanged, no destination and no staging leftovers.

reviewed_contracts.assessment: 32-bit sign-bit class references use ARCH-relative class declaration offsets. Positive object references use registered payload-length-field offsets. Each -2 declaration records its own class/version. Missing class fallback is bounded to earlier explicit -1 declarations, intentionally excluding native state-dependent -2 fallback. No scan recovery.

Byte cursors enforce enclosing extents. Class/object counts and recursive depth are bounded. Unknown positive references throw. Active list identities and globally encountered track identities reject recursive/shared-track duplication. Concrete class versions are checked on interpreted paths; unknown event kinds/tails remain opaque and do not become playable clips.

22-byte records and complete u16 boolean agree with original reader. Nonzero selects fixedf32 directly; map mode does not substitute inactive fixed value. Nonfinite/out-of-range fixed values reject. Map coordinates and ramps remain unsupported.
Metadata BPM/rate/signature remain descriptive facts. Imported name/rate/signature/mixer/timebase defaults are explicit. Metadata does not silently set timing maps.

Current path reads produce dependency diagnostics only; no filesystem resolution, implicit media extraction or playable clip is invented. Root-native evidence supports field framing; timeline/source units remain unbound.

Import writes exact source and baseline report toCompatibility/CPR, verifies bytes, reloads project and report before destination publication. compatibilityReport verifies source/hash/sections and recomputed interpretation, rejects symlink redirection. StudioSession Save As copies all original children exceptProject.json, therefore includesCompatibility; only edited Project.json/name changes. cprCompatibility remains a historical baseline, not a claim about later edits. This Save As assessment is static source review, not a GUI execution.

test_evidence.origin: Implementation agent ran focused CPRProjectTests; reviewer checked retained log, final exact source hashes and targeted control bodies without rerunning the suite.
test_evidence.scope: Self-authored malformed/bounded controls plus read-only exact shipped-template parsing and candidate package persistence. No Cubase runtime acceptance or conformance test.

snapshot_note: initial-* snapshots were captured after R1/R2 were already patched and before R3. They are intermediate reviewed snapshots, not the original defective revision. final-* snapshots pin the completed revision.

No full adversarial fuzzing, reference-graph exhaustive proof, or GUI Save As exercise by this reviewer. Root owns GUI verification.

Imported project contains audio track skeletons and a bounded active-fixed-tempo subset only; clips, MIDI, instruments, routing, automation, plugin state, tempo-map coordinates and signatures remain preserved or unsupported.
Native runtime comparison count remains zero; all native observations are static.
